newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ONE CORPORATE STOCK TRADES ON BULGARIA BOURSES.
newsitem.headline: ONE CORPORATE STOCK TRADES ON BULGARIA BOURSES.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Wednesday's 41.02 points as Varna Grand Hotel traded unchanged, brokers said.

This company sold 40 shares at 87 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange, flat from Wednesday's close and below par of 100. This was the only deal in corporate stocks on the local stock market for Thursday.
There were no repo deals in treasury paper on local bourses today.
